ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): One of the best movies I have ever seen, a must see that blew me away with its complexity, sharp detail and top gear script.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, a psychiatrist becomes increasingly convinced she is being threatened by an uncanny entity.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): One of the greatest horror movies ever made. Exceptionally intense and doesn't hold back for a moment as it plunges you into the depths of the mind with a smile.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, it traces the rise and fall of multiple characters during an era of unbridled decadence and depravity in early Hollywood.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): An epic film that winds up much deeper than expected, felt like I was watching the end of Hollywood.

ipc-title__text: 4. All Quiet on the Western Front
ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young German soldier's eagerness to serve his country quickly fades when he witnesses the horrors of combat on the Western Front during World War I.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A film that showcases the brutality and horror of war. Possibly the most intense and dark movie about war I have ever seen, a picture without glory.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young Viking prince is on a quest to avenge his father's murder.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): One of the best revenge films I've seen in a long time. Exceptional execution on all fronts for one of the best films of 2022.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A chef must deal with pressures in and out of the kitchen of a high end restaurant in the Christmas rush.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): As a human who works in restaurants myself, this is probably the best (and most realistic) film about the food industry ever made.

ipc-title__text: 7. Bardo: False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths
ipc-html-content-inner-div: An acclaimed documentarian goes on an introspective journey through surreal dreamscapes to reconcile with the past, the present and his Mexican identity.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A wonderful film, kinda reminded me of Vanilla Sky but with more of a center on family, history and making movies. Deep narrative with some beautiful cinematography.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Great dark comedy movie about friendship and division through the boredom of day to day existence on an island. Deeper than you'd expect.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: When a group of rich 20-somethings plan a hurricane party at a remote family mansion, a party game turns deadly.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A hilarious look at the self destruction of woke culture.

ipc-title__text: 10. Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe
ipc-html-content-inner-div: After a "creative" judge sentences them to space camp, a black hole sends our adolescent heroes 24 years into the modern future where the duo misuse iPhones, embark on a quest to score, and become targets of the Deep State.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): One of the funniest movies ever made. The most I have actually laughed out loud this year and I watched this movie alone.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: When Dr. Robotnik returns with a new partner, Knuckles, in search of an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations, Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, on a journey across the world to find the emerald first.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Didn't expect to enjoy this one really, but I love this movie. All the characters are great and the story is fun. Even better than the first and maybe the best video game movie out.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): I've never seen a movie quite like this one. It really caught me off guard, but ended up being one of my new favorite films of all time. Heart, humor and the chaos of modern life all intertwine to tell this absurd fantasy tale that everyone should go see.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Just great to see a good old fashioned American movie.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young couple trying to reunite amid a city ravaged by a plague that turns its victims into deranged, bloodthirsty sadists.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Maybe the most crazy horror movie I've ever seen, and that's saying a lot. Maybe too crazy. Intense & way, way over the top.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: In 1987 Poland, a police officer investigating mysterious disappearances infiltrates a remote monastery and discovers a dark truth about its clergy.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A great religious horror movie with some unexpected (and quite hilarious) twists and turns.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: While her husband leaves home every day to work in a top secret facility, a young 1950s housewife begins to question her life when she notices strange behavior from the other wives in the neighborhood.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A woke movie done well with a great twist at the end. Enjoy this movie & just remember that order is still a good thing and men aren't collectively bad. Usually skip out on the woke movies as a personal protest, but in the name of loving film this is certainly worth a watch no matter your world views.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: What happens next with Frylock, Meatwad and Master Shake, who consider themselves crime fighters, but the truth is they never fight crime.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Great fun animation, goes hard on Amazon, which I personally love, but still a fantastic comedy with a lot to show for.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A famous movie producer gives her young production assistant a chance to direct his first film.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): An animated movie about the love for movies, one of my new favorite films and a great surprise to come across.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: In 1918, a young woman on the brink of madness pursues stardom in a desperate attempt to escape the drudgery, isolation, and lovelessness of life on her parents' farm.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Loved this movie. If you enjoyed X, you'll love this one as well. Makes the first film even better and was a great surprise too as I had no idea this was all going to be a series.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in a rural Texas farm, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the crew find themselves fighting for their lives.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): The best horror movie since Hereditary and the most fun horror movie since Cabin in the Woods.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: In 2003, a trio of mercenaries escaping a coup in Guinea-Bissau take refuge in a hidden region on the Saloum river of Senegal. But something from beyond the grave awaits them there.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Great action horror movie I had never heard of till it came out. Top notch characters and acting set the stage for the unfolding of bizarre story.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Influencers looking to breathe new life into a Texas ghost town encounter Leatherface, an infamous killer who wears a mask of human skin.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): For horror movie reboots, remakes and sequels, this is certainly one of the better ones. If enjoy any of these past movies, you'll enjoy this one for damn sure. Ignore the reviews, its a fun, simple and raw horror movie.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: The residents of a lonely gulch in inland California bear witness to an uncanny and chilling phenomenon.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Loved this movie. A perfect mixture of scifi, western & horror with a refreshing sense of adventure.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Teen Suzu embarks on an epic quest to uncover the identity of a mysterious beast in a virtual world.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A beautifully animated film about the potential of a functioning meta verse. Like a future tech upgrade to the classic Beauty and the Beast story with heart, humor and actually cool music.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: After a breakup, Wes ends up at a remote rest stop. He finds himself locked inside the bathroom with a mysterious figure speaking from an adjacent stall. Soon Wes realizes he is involved in a situation more terrible than he could imagine.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A wild cosmic horror indie picture, certainly worth a watch if you are a Lovecraft fan.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: An expert cutter must outwit a dangerous group of mobsters in order to survive a fateful night.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Didn't know what to expect with this film, but was pleasantly surprised by its style and wit. One of the best mystery thrillers I've seen in a while.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: The Assassin travels through a nightmare underworld of tortured souls, ruined cities and wretched monstrosities forged from the primordial horrors of the unconscious mind of Phil Tippett, the world's preeminent stop-motion animator.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): I love the work that went into this film. More of a visual experience than a story and certainly worth watching once. It's pretty dark and some parts are kinda gross, but it's unlike anything ever seen.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: An American priest working in Mexico is possessed during an exorcism and ends up committing a terrible act. Eighteen years later, the consequences of his sin come back to haunt him, unleashing the greatest battle within.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): One of the best exorcism movies I've seen recently, or ever for that matter. I expected this to be lame, but everyone involved did a great job with what and who they had to work with. Well done story, characters, horror and the ending was worth the watch.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling on a collision course toward earth.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A fun original movie with some interesting sci fi twists. One of the better disaster movies, but not great. If you enjoyed Independence Day or Day After Tomorrow, you'll most likely enjoy this one as well.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Wall Street data analyst Richard Boca sees ominous patterns: His computer models are behaving erratically, as are the swarms of mosquitos breeding in his apartment, an infestation that attends his psychological meltdown.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): An interesting psychological thriller about the economy and modern times. Watch this for a deep and mysterious little indie movie if that sounds interesting to you.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: The life of American music icon Elvis Presley, from his childhood to becoming a rock and movie star in the 1950s while maintaining a complex relationship with his manager, Colonel Tom Parker.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Had some great fun watching this one. Wasn't really a fan of Elvis before I saw the film, but it's a great story and has some great music. One of my new favorite movies about music.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Naru, a skilled warrior of the Comanche Nation, fights to protect her tribe against one of the first highly-evolved Predators to land on Earth.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Big fan of the Predator movies, this one does a great job and may be my favorite of all the newer installments to the series.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A cinematic odyssey exploring David Bowie's creative and musical journey. From visionary filmmaker Brett Morgen, and sanctioned by the Bowie estate.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Now this is a trippy movie. Like a music video movie that paints a wonderful picture of who David Bowie is without a set story arc or narrative. Well done and fun, wether you are a fan of his work or not.

ipc-title__text: 34. Rose Blood: A Friday the 13th Fan Film
ipc-html-content-inner-div: Takes place 13 months after Friday The 13th Part VII. We follow Tina Shepard as she is held and studied at the infamous Camp Crystal Lake Research Facility. Tina realizes that she is not alone. There in fact is another New Blood. Rose.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): The best F13 fan film out there, which there are more than a few. They did a great job with this one and despite only being filmed at one location, the cast, script and, of course, Jason, all come together to provide an excellent indie experience. Find it on youtube and have some fun.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Tech billionaire Miles Bron invites his friends for a getaway on his private Greek island. When someone turns up dead, Detective Benoit Blanc is put on the case.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Another fun netflix movie. The mystery is fun to watch unravel and the characters are all a joy to experience, but the film itself never quite reaches the realms of greatness.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young boy learns that a superhero who was thought to have died after an epic battle twenty-five years ago may in fact still be alive.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Pretty good Amazon Original, a goofy superhero movie with a twist of realism. Better than many of the marvel movies.

ipc-title__text: 37. The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
ipc-html-content-inner-div: Movie star Nick Cage must channel his iconic screen characters when he finds himself caught in-between a dangerous super-fan and a CIA agent.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A must watch for Cage fans. Just well done fun.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: The last survivor of a band of warriors is enslaved in a salt mine. One night, savage dogs attack and a mysterious disease wipes out everyone at the mine. The warrior escapes with a little girl, while a gifted physician looks for a cure.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A decent animated movie in the same vein as Princess Mononoke but not anywhere near as great. Still worth a watch.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A fashion model celebrity couple join an eventful cruise for the super-rich.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Great movie, great cast, great characters, awful ending. Fun but ultimately a huge letdown.

ipc-title__text: 40. Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
ipc-html-content-inner-div: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Didn't meet the hype, but certainly had its moments of ridiculous special effects. Another fun one to watch & if you're a fan of the first film, this isn't as good, but you will still enjoy it.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Legendary rock band Foo Fighters move into an Encino mansion steeped in grisly rock and roll history to record their much anticipated 10th album.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A good horror film, the band makes it even better. Far from the best, but still a fun one to watch, especially for any fans out there.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: Deep in the Dovre mountain, something gigantic wakes up after a thousand years in captivity. The creature destroys everything in its path and quickly approaches Oslo.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A fun netflix movie, nothing too great but worth an evening watch if you are bored.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A woman staying at an Airbnb discovers that the house she has rented is not what it seems.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Original, but maybe so much so that it just becomes odd and not in a great way. Worth a watch once if you enjoy horror movies.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: During the bright Nordic summer, a group of children reveal their dark and mysterious powers when the adults aren't looking. In this original and gripping supernatural thriller, playtime takes a dangerous turn.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A strange film about kids with psychic powers, certainly worth a watch to any horror fans out there.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A young woman goes on a solo vacation to the English countryside following the death of her ex-husband.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A strange woke nightmare that doesn't really make much sense, but still is an interesting film to watch.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A father and his two teenage daughters find themselves hunted by a massive rogue lion intent on proving that the savanna has but one apex predator.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Decent animal horror, worth watching once for the characters and cinematography.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A group of bickering suburbanites find themselves stuck together when an android uprising causes their well intentioned household robots to lock them in for their own safety.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Interesting, but far from great. Some of the ideas and comedy surrounding potential aspects of the future were well done, and it does come with a few genuine laughs, but all and all it still falls short of expectation and execution.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A lonely scholar, on a trip to Istanbul, discovers a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Enjoyable but had a hard time getting into this one. Fun for an afternoon watch without expectation, but nothing great here.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): A good movie, but not quite a great one. A worthy addition to the Batman films, more of a crime thriller than an action movie and this certainly works for the dark atmosphere that the film creates. Worth seeing on the big screen.

ipc-html-content-inner-div: A reclusive and controversial author is drawn out of hiding when he begins to receive endless letters from an obsessive fan.
ipc-html-content-inner-div (2): Good but not great thriller with an interesting setup. As a writer I enjoyed watching it once.
